data.description: Dubai World Trade Centre – A Global Hub of Innovation and Opportunity.

data.answer:
The Dubai Trade Center is a well-planned mixed-use development that seamlessly combines commercial projects, residential properties, retail spaces, and administrative hubs. The complex features the 14-story Convention Tower, which stands adjacent to the expansive Dubai International Convention and Exhibition Centre. Surrounding the exhibition grounds are key landmarks such as Sheikh Rashid Tower, Novotel Hotel, and Ibis Hotel, catering to business travelers and event attendees alike.

On the residential side, the development is home to Jumeirah Living – World Trade Centre Residence, offering upscale living in the heart of the city. Convenient connectivity is ensured by the World Trade Centre Metro Station, which also provides direct access to The Plaza and Exhibition Gate, two key venues for outdoor events. With its prime location along Dubai World Trade Centre Sheikh Zayed Road Dubai, the area remains a central hub for business and commerce.

Beyond its commercial and residential offerings, the Dubai Trade Center is renowned for its extensive exhibition facilities. The complex includes state-of-the-art venues such as Sheikh Rashid Hall, Sheikh Saeed Halls, Sheikh Maktoum Hall, and the Trade Centre Arena, all of which host global conventions, trade shows, and industry events throughout the year.

The Dubai World Trade Centre apartments offer a blend of luxury and convenience in one of Dubai’s most prestigious locations. The development includes a mix of commercial and residential properties, with a strong focus on premium office spaces and high-end serviced residences. 

A standard 1-bedroom serviced apartment covers approximately 900 sq. ft., featuring modern ensuite bathrooms, widescreen LCD TVs, and complimentary access to premium facilities. The larger 1-bed duplexes and 2-bed residences range from 1,160 sq. ft. to 2,180 sq. ft., while 3-bed panoramic duplexes offer between 2,460 sq. ft. and 2,730 sq. ft. 

Popular Buildings in Dubai Trade Center Area

One of the most iconic landmarks in the Trade Center area is the Trade Centre Tower, formerly known as Sheikh Rashid Tower. Standing 149 meters tall with 39 floors, it was once the tallest skyscraper in the Middle East and remains a symbol of international trade. It even holds a place on the AED 100 currency note, emphasizing its historical significance. Another key development is the Jumeirah Living – World Trade Centre Residence, which consists of two towers housing 377 luxurious serviced apartments, including 1 to 4-bedroom units and duplexes. These residences offer state-of-the-art amenities, from fully equipped kitchens to private beach access, ensuring an elevated living experience.

Another prominent residential option is Jumeirah Living – World Trade Centre Residence, which features upscale living spaces with world-class amenities. Residents benefit from a fitness center, a rooftop pool, and exclusive dining options, making it a sought-after address for professionals and families alike.

Off-Plan Projects in Dubai Trade Center District

The Dubai Trade Center district is already a well-established commercial and residential hub, with limited new off-plan developments. However, future projects in the area are expected to enhance the skyline further, introducing more high-end residences and commercial spaces to accommodate the growing demand. Investors interested in upcoming projects should keep an eye on potential expansions that align with Dubai’s vision of becoming a global business and lifestyle hub.

Renting a Property in Dubai WTC

Renting in Dubai WTC provides access to a strategic location with excellent transport links and high-end amenities. The rental prices for Dubai World Trade Centre apartments vary depending on size and type. 

  • 1-Bedroom – AED 113,000
  • 2-Bedroom – AED 180,000
  • 3-Bedroom – AED 358,000
  • 4-Bedroom – AED 365,000

Buying a Property in Dubai Trade Center

For those looking to invest, Dubai Trade Center district offers a limited but highly valuable selection of high-end residences. Duplex apartments are particularly in demand, with prices ranging between AED 1.2M and AED 6.5M. 

The exclusivity and central location make these properties a prime choice for investors seeking capital appreciation and rental income opportunities. With its strong historical significance and excellent connectivity to key business hubs, the Trade Center area remains a top-tier investment destination in Dubai.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in the Dubai Trade Center Area?

data.answer:
Living in the Dubai Trade Center area means being at the heart of Dubai’s commercial and social scene, surrounded by world-class business hubs, luxury residences, and top-tier amenities. With seamless connectivity, upscale dining, and vibrant events, this district offers a dynamic lifestyle for professionals and families alike.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Dubai World Trade Center

The Dubai World Trade Centre enjoys excellent connectivity, with seamless access to three major roads: Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), 2nd Zabeel Street (D73), and Happiness Street (D86). This prime location ensures smooth commutes for both residents and visitors, whether traveling by car or public transport.

Parking is plentiful throughout the district, with designated areas along Happiness Street and within the complex. Options include free and paid parking, valet services, and electric vehicle charging stations, making it convenient for all types of commuters.

For those relying on public transport, the Dubai World Trade Centre Metro station, situated on the Red Line, provides a fast and efficient way to reach key business hubs and attractions across the city. Additionally, several bus stops near Novotel Hotel and Jumeirah Living – World Trade Centre Residence offer further accessibility for daily commuters.

Supermarkets in Dubai Trade Center District

For grocery and home essentials, residents in the Trade Center area have convenient options nearby. Fair Trade Supermarket & Department Store, located near the Ibis World Trade Centre Dubai Hotel, offers a variety of daily necessities. Additionally, a ZOOM convenience store is situated right across from WTC, making quick shopping effortless.

For a more extensive selection, Carrefour Market in Duja Tower, just across Sheikh Zayed Road, provides a wide range of fresh produce and household products at competitive prices. As one of the well-stocked supermarkets in the Dubai Trade Center district, it caters to both everyday shopping and bulk purchases, ensuring convenience for residents and professionals in the area.

Shopping Malls Near Dubai World Trade Center

Most shopping complexes in the World Trade Centre primarily cater to business-to-business trade; however, some also offer consumer goods. These centers provide a mix of retail experiences, serving both corporate clients and casual shoppers.

For those seeking a more diverse shopping experience, Dubai Mall is a premier destination, featuring an extensive selection of luxury brands and entertainment options. Covering an impressive 502,000 square meters across four levels, this world-renowned mall is located in the heart of Downtown Dubai and can be reached within a 10-minute drive.

Another convenient option is Al Ghazal Mall, a compact shopping complex in Al Badaa. Just 10 minutes away, it offers a more intimate retail environment for those looking for everyday essentials and boutique stores.

Schools and Nurseries in Dubai Trade Center Area

Families living in Dubai World Trade Centre have access to a variety of educational institutions, ranging from nurseries to higher education centers. For preschoolers, options such as Smart Children’s Nursery, Roots and Wings Nursery, and StepUp Nursery in the nearby Al Jafiliya community are just a 7-minute drive away. Other reputable nurseries include Hummingbird Nursery DIFC, its extension Hummingbird Pre-school DIFC, Safari Kid Sheikh Zayed Road Nursery, and Grassland Daycare & Nursery, all providing quality early childhood education.

For primary and secondary schooling, parents can enroll their children in GEMS Wellington Primary School, Salma Al Ansaria School, Al Wasl Girls School, and Al Maktoum Primary School for Boys. These schools are located in Al Satwa and can be reached in under 10 minutes from Dubai WTC.

Higher education opportunities are also available in the area, with Dubai College of Tourism, located near Ibis One Central Hotel, offering specialized courses in tourism, events, hospitality, retail, and culinary arts. Business professionals can benefit from training programs at Philippine Business School, Champion Traders Academy, and Blue Ocean Academy. Additionally, language learners can find the Chinese Language Institute at The H Hotel, while the Arabic Language Centre (ALC) is conveniently situated on the 4th floor of Sheikh Rashid Tower, making Dubai World Trade Centre a hub for diverse learning opportunities.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Dubai WTC

The Dubai Trade Center district provides easy access to various places of worship, catering to different faiths. For the Christian community, several churches are located in Oud Metha, approximately 7.7 kilometers away. A 10-minute drive via Sheikh Zayed Road leads to notable churches such as St. Mary’s Catholic Church, The Dubai City Church, and St. Thomas Orthodox Cathedral Dubai, along with many others serving various denominations.

For those following Buddhism or Hinduism, temples are also within reach. The Mahamevnawa Buddhist Temple in Al Wasl is one of the closest options. Hindu temples, including Shiva Temple, Shree Krishna Haveli, and ShrinathJi Temple, are all located in Bur Dubai, just a short 10-minute drive from DWTC.

While there is no mosque within the Trade Center area, worshippers can visit Al Shaikh Hamdan Bin Rashid Al Maktoum Masjid, accessible within a 7-minute drive. Additionally, several mosques are located across Sheikh Zayed Road, providing convenient options for the Muslim community.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Dubai Trade Center

Residents of Dubai World Trade Centre Sheikh Zayed Road Dubai have easy access to essential medical services. For prescriptions and over-the-counter medications, Life Pharmacy, located within the exhibition complex, provides a convenient option.

In case of medical emergencies, several clinics and hospitals are available nearby, particularly along Sheikh Zayed Road. Notable facilities include Emirates Hospital Clinics, Gulf Eye Centre, Zain Specialized Clinic, and GMCClinics, all offering a range of healthcare services.

For more specialized treatment, residents can visit hospitals in Dubai Healthcare City, which is less than a 10-minute drive away. Leading medical institutions such as Mediclinic City Hospital, Emirates Specialty Hospital, American Hospital Dubai, and Latifa Hospital ensure top-tier healthcare solutions within close proximity to Dubai World Trade Centre.

Location & Nearby Areas

Situated along Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai World Trade Centre Sheikh Zayed Road Dubai enjoys close proximity to some of the city's most prominent districts. Heading down the highway past Emirates Towers, you’ll arrive at Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), the city’s leading financial hub. Continuing further, you’ll reach the iconic Downtown Dubai and the bustling Business Bay, both known for their skyscrapers, luxury residences, and commercial spaces.

Opposite the Dubai World Trade Centre lies Al Satwa, a diverse and vibrant community that embodies Dubai’s multicultural spirit. With its mix of residential and commercial properties, Al Satwa adds to the dynamic landscape surrounding the Dubai WTC, making it an integral part of the city's urban fabric

more_info.question: Things to Do in Dubai World Trade Center

data.answer:
The Dubai World Trade Centre is more than just a business hub—it’s a dynamic destination offering world-class events, exhibitions, dining, and entertainment experiences.

Restaurants

The Dubai Trade Center District offers an impressive selection of dining options, catering to every palate and preference. From casual eateries to upscale fine dining, this vibrant area is packed with international cuisines and popular food spots, making it a go-to destination for both residents and visitors.

Just outside the convention gates near the metro station, several casual dining spots serve up delicious meals. Burgerfuel is a favorite for gourmet burgers, while Pizza Express specializes in hand-tossed pizzas. For sushi lovers, Sushi Counter offers a variety of fresh Japanese delights. Those looking for a relaxed café experience can head to Circle Café for an international menu with popular daily specials or stop by Caffe Nero for coffee and sweet treats. Meanwhile, The Club Lounge, located on the 30th floor of The World Trade Centre Residences, provides an elegant dining experience with an à la carte menu in a refined setting.

The district is also home to several renowned hotels along Sheikh Zayed Road, offering some of the city's best restaurants and nightlife. For authentic Asian cuisine, diners can visit Wagamama at the Crowne Plaza Hotel or experience a sophisticated dining atmosphere at Play Restaurant and Lounge in The H Hotel. Those craving Lebanese flavors can enjoy traditional delicacies at Yeldizlar in the Fairmont Dubai or Al Nafoorah in Jumeirah Emirates Towers.

For a laid-back evening, McGettigan’s Irish Pub is a popular social hub known for its hearty menu and lively atmosphere. Several stylish coffee spots are also within reach, including Miss Lily’s at the Sheraton Grand Hotel, the Level 43 Sky Lounge at Four Points by Sheraton Sheikh Zayed Road, and Alta Badia Bar at Jumeirah Emirates Towers, all offering exceptional views and a relaxed ambiance.

Beaches Near Dubai World Trade Center

Residents of Dubai Trade Center District enjoy the advantage of being just a short distance from Dubai’s stunning coastline. The city’s most famous beachfront destinations, including Jumeirah Beach, La Mer Beach, and the Public Beach, are only a few kilometers away. Whether it's a relaxing day by the sea, water sports, or a scenic sunset stroll, these beaches offer the perfect outdoor retreat for those living near Dubai World Trade Centre.

Hotels Near Dubai World Trade Center

Whether you're seeking a short-term retreat or a long-term residence, the Dubai World Trade Centre apartments offer a luxurious and convenient living experience. With fully furnished and serviced units across three residential blocks, the development caters to diverse lifestyle needs, ensuring comfort and accessibility in a prime location.

For visitors and business travelers, hotels near Dubai World Trade Centre provide excellent accommodation options. Among them, the 4-star Novotel Hotel stands out with 412 elegant suites and world-class amenities, including a beauty salon, state-of-the-art gym, outdoor swimming pool, free valet parking, and a selection of fine dining restaurants and bars, making it an ideal choice for a seamless stay.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

For families looking for a fun-filled outing, Dubai Garden Glow offers a vibrant and unique thematic park experience. Conveniently located where Sheikh Zayed Road curves off from the Trade Centre Roundabout, this attraction is part of the larger Zabeel Park, which is also home to the iconic Dubai Frame.

Beyond sightseeing, Zabeel Park offers a range of recreational facilities, making weekends more engaging for residents and visitors alike. The park features an amphitheater for live performances, covered barbecue areas, an ice rink, jogging tracks, a mini golf course, a cricket pitch, and a skateboard park. Additionally, children can enjoy an adventure playground, while visitors can unwind with a boat ride on the lake. During summer, a 25,000 sq. m. indoor sports complex called Dubai Sports World opens, providing a climate-controlled space for various sporting activities and events.

For adventure enthusiasts, The Wall Dubai at Dorell Sports is a standout attraction, boasting the highest outdoor climbing wall in the emirate. With an impressive height of 18 meters, this facility is designed for both beginners and experienced climbers, offering a thrilling experience for all ages.

Fitness-conscious individuals have access to several top-tier gyms and wellness centers near Dubai World Trade Centre. Popular options include 1 Beat Gym, Talise Fitness at Jumeirah Emirates Towers, Crowne Fitness Studio, Fit Inc., and Fitness Avenue, each providing state-of-the-art equipment and specialized workout programs.

When it comes to beauty and self-care, the area is home to several high-end salons and spas. Aurora Beauty Centre and Spa, Donna Ricci Salon, NStyle Beauty Lounge, and Sa Scène Hair Couture offer a range of beauty and grooming services. Additionally, Caractère by Dani Salons, located in Novotel Hotel, provides upscale hair and beauty treatments catering to both men and women, making it a go-to destination for luxurious pampering.

Community Events

As a premier event venue, Dubai World Trade Centre hosts a diverse range of exhibitions, conferences, and trade shows throughout the year. Some of the most notable annual events include GITEX Technology Week, Beautyworld, Gulfood, and Arab Health, attracting global professionals and industry leaders.

In addition to large-scale exhibitions, the venue also accommodates niche events catering to various sectors. During Ramadan, the WTC Ramadan Market becomes a bustling hub for seasonal shopping. The exclusive Majlis at Dubai World Trade Centre is another highlight, offering an elegant setting for iftar buffets and suhoor menus, creating a memorable experience for visitors during the holy month.

Attractions and Landmarks

For those seeking a lively nightlife scene, the Cavalli Club Restaurant and Lounge at Fairmont Dubai offers an upscale clubbing experience. Adorned with Swarovski crystals and exuding luxury, this iconic venue is located right opposite Dubai World Trade Centre, making it a prime destination for an unforgettable night out.

History enthusiasts can explore the Etihad Museum, a cultural landmark showcasing the rich heritage of the United Arab Emirates. Situated on Jumeirah Street, this architecturally stunning museum is just a 15-minute drive along Al Diyafah Street, offering an insightful journey into the nation’s past.

Meanwhile, those fascinated by innovation and technology will be captivated by the Museum of the Future. Located adjacent to Emirates Towers, this 342,292 sq. ft. marvel features an eye-catching exterior adorned with Arabic calligraphy, symbolizing Dubai’s vision of progress.

Among the city’s iconic structures, the Emirates Towers stand out with their striking design. Comprising the 56-story Jumeirah Emirates Towers Hotel and the 54-floor Emirates Office Tower, this architectural duo dominates the skyline along Sheikh Zayed Road. Additionally, residents of Dubai World Trade Centre can enjoy breathtaking views of the Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest building, soaring to an impressive height of 828 meters and located just a short distance away.

With its vibrant event calendar, residents and professionals have access to some of the region’s most prestigious exhibitions, trade shows, and cultural gatherings. Additionally, the surrounding areas boast an excellent selection of dining, shopping, and recreational options, ensuring a well-rounded urban experience.

Where is the Dubai World Trade Centre located?

Dubai World Trade Centre is a major business hub in the city, positioned along Sheikh Zayed Road, one of Dubai’s busiest highways.

What was the former name of Dubai World Trade Centre?

Previously, it was known as Sheikh Rashid Tower before evolving into the expansive trade and exhibition complex it is today.

Who is the owner of Dubai World Trade Centre?

The Government of Dubai owns and manages the Dubai World Trade Centre.

When was the Dubai World Trade Centre constructed?

The construction of the complex began in 1974 and was completed in 1979.

Which is the oldest building in Dubai?

Al Fahidi Fort holds the title of the oldest existing structure in Dubai. However, the Dubai World Trade Centre was the first skyscraper built on Sheikh Zayed Road.

How far is Dubai World Trade Centre from Dubai International Airport?

Dubai World Trade Centre is located approximately 10 kilometers from Dubai International Airport (DXB), making it easily accessible within a 15-minute drive via Sheikh Zayed Road.

data.content:
The Dubai World Trade Centre (Dubai WTC) stands as one of the most dynamic and bustling locations in the city. Strategically positioned along Sheikh Zayed Road, the community is at the heart of Dubai’s business and financial hub, alongside prominent districts like Downtown Dubai, DIFC, and Business Bay. More than just a commercial destination, the trade center serves as a major venue for global conventions, exhibitions, and high-profile events, playing a pivotal role in advancing international trade in the Middle East.

Originally known as Sheikh Rashid Tower, the Dubai WTC was constructed in 1979 and held the title of Dubai’s tallest building at 149 meters with 39 floors. What began as a single tower has expanded into a sprawling 1.3-million-square-foot complex, featuring 21 exhibition halls, 40 meeting rooms, and several commercial towers and hotels. With its direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro’s Red Line, the development is seamlessly connected to key business and lifestyle hubs.

As a cornerstone of economic activity, the Dubai World Trade Centre significantly contributes to Dubai’s revenue and employment landscape. Its world-class infrastructure and central location make it a preferred destination for multinational businesses and global investors. Hosting a diverse range of events, trade shows, and cultural gatherings, Dubai WTC continues to reinforce its status as the region’s leading hub for commerce and networking.
